description.text: Starter Set VMAX Grimmsnarl, a 60-card deck released on 27 March 2020 with Charizard's, each guaranteed one Pokémon VMAX. Grimmsnarl V's Spiky Knuckle and Grimmsnarl VMAX's G-Max Drill each cost three Darkness Energy, and G-Max Drill reaches 270 damage with five attached; Hydreigon's Ability Dark Squall puts Darkness Energy from the hand into play at once. Both decks have the new Item Rotom Phone, which looks at the top five cards of the deck and puts one of them on top. A playmat, a coin, damage counters and markers and a player's guide came with each.
